bullets.text: carrying less today, mostly by leaving things behind and calling it discipline.
duck at sekkei-ji. a feather hit the stones, the wind took it, nothing protested.
the borrowed line says travel light, physically and otherwise. the to-do list disagrees.
lighter than yesterday. the kind of light that doesn't show up on a scale.
the backpack and i are negotiating which of us is the dead weight.
